description: Decide how much review a task warrants, skip, spot_check or full, from its routing hints. Records a route_decision artefact giving the rule that produced the answer.

artefact_routing_hints.description: Per-artefact signals such as confidence, model_id and cost_consumed_usd, merged over the task's routing_hints for this call. The default policy reads criticality and confidence. If the merged set is empty the call is refused with -32514. Fractional values are written as decimal strings, e.g. "confidence": "0.86".
